question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Opaque
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'** i.e.** 'Arcane'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word that means the same as the given word **"Opaque"** is **"Arcane".**
 
• **"Opaque" **can refer to something that is not able to be seen through; not transparent.(अपारदर्शी, अस्पष्ट)
 
• In a more metaphorical sense, it can also refer to something that is hard to understand or is not clear.
 
• **"Arcane"** refers to something that is understood by few; mysterious or secret.(गुप्त, रहस्यमय)
 
• It is **often used to** describe knowledge that's restricted to the person who possesses it. 

Therefore, the** correct answer** is:** 'Arcane'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Now, let's look at the meanings of the other words:
 
 
• **Unadulterated: **This means not mixed or diluted with any different or extra elements; complete and absolute. (शुद्ध, अमिश्रित)
 
• **Translucent: **This refers to allowing light, but not detailed shapes, to pass through; semitransparent. (अर्धपारदर्शी)
 
• **Clear: **This refers to something that is easy to perceive, understand, or interpret. (स्पष्ट, पारदर्शी)
